data.one_liner: Flutter widgets for displaying and editing syntax-highlighted code.
data.what_it_does: Provides CodeView for rendering syntax-highlighted source code with optional line numbers and wrapping, and CodeField for editing code with features like auto-closing brackets and comment toggling.
use_when: You need to display syntax-highlighted code blocks in your app.
You are building a code editor or scratchpad interface within Flutter.
avoid_when: You just need a plain multiline text field without code editing enhancements.
strengths: Smooth performance on large files with lazy rendering and background isolates.
Includes editing features like bracket auto-closing, smart indentation, and comment toggling.
weaknesses: Coloured window movement in large CodeFields can occasionally cause layout recalculations.
